scope: Read-only review of reuse/orchestration semantics, not independent retraining
findings: Reused historical job.json must remain unchanged because its hash is part of the completion record.
native.collect uses corrected prepared specs and fold predictions/checkpoints, not old job paths.
Exact unchanged data/spec/fold checks plus OOF/query ID checks support reusing mtaux8 and2d6single.
Only affected components are scheduled for new fits.
limitation: Historical complete.json records lack an embedded job_identity; provenance is bound through recovered prepared/final manifests, native-source hashes, metadata/hyperparameters, fold membership and file hashes.
